{{Quote|They're fast! They're shiny! They soar, they spin, they explode! Swoop bikes! Do you love swooping? Don't answer! We know you do. If you love it so much, why are you still watching this? Get yourself to the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally and start your engines! Don't be the only laser brain who misses out on the biggest swoop event in one hundred years!|B4-N9 interrupts regularly scheduled programming on Galaxywide NewsNets to announce the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally|<ref name="Swoop-Carrick" />}}
'''B4-N9''' served as the announcer of the [[All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally]].<ref name="Dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=location|Dantooine}}</ref> Built and programmed by [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] riders and enthusiasts for [[Gender/Legends|his]] characteristic volume and energy,<ref name="Swoop-Dantooine">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=general|The All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally|Dantooine}}</ref> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] operated as the live commentator of the All Worlds Ultimate Swoop Rally. To advertise the rally, B4-N9 hijacked a [[Galaxywide NewsNets]] newscast from [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], leading to [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] to investigate the event.<ref name="Swoop-Carrick" /> The Commander arrived at the Swoop Rally on Dantooine to find the retired swoop racer [[Zella]], who, when asked of the intense droid who interrupted the news, referred to the droid as '''Beefour''' and spoke of his role in the rally. Zella further encouraged the Commander to discover the thrill of swoop racing by becoming acquainted with [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop leaders]], who in turn convinced the Alliance leader to participate in the swoop event<ref name="Swoop-Dantooine" /> with B4-N9 providing commentary.<ref name="Dantooine" />

B4-N9's commentary included remarks such as "Keep that boost going!," "Brilliant maneuvers!," and "Now that's gonna leave a mark!" B4-N9's commentary was also composed of exclamations such as "Are! You! READY!" and "Alley-OOOOOP! Yes!" as well as pointing out observations such as "Smooth as Nexu hide!" and "Now that's skills, folks!"<ref name="Dantooine" />

{{Droid-stub}}
